title: Signal: Package manifest with no tools version
scope: A Package.swift file that declares a manifest that declares no Swift tools version.
limitations: It matches a manifest that declares no Swift tools version in the parsed Package.swift; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A Package.swift that mentions a manifest that declares no Swift tools version in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
